# 0xelitesystem

> 362 open-source repos by one operator: 204 zero-dependency single-file browser tools with live demos, and 158 plain-language references on security, AI/LLM practice, SEO, indie operations, and market literacy.

Every tool is one HTML file that runs entirely in the browser: no frameworks, no CDN, no analytics, no build step, MIT licensed. Every tool has a live demo at https://0xelitesystem.github.io/<repo-name>/. The references lead with direct answers and are written to be cited. The operator hub is https://elitesystem.ai.

## Start here

- [Searchable index of all 362 repos](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/): one page, instant search, tools and references filterable.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/catalog.json): JSON array of every repo with slug, type (tool or ref), and one-line description.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/0xelitesystem): all repositories.

## The agent accountability suite

Five zero-dependency Python CLIs that audit a finished AI coding-agent session by mining its transcript:

- [agent-receipts](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/agent-receipts): verifies the agent's claims ("tests pass", "committed") against tool-call exit codes, filesystem, and git state.
- [agent-leaks](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/agent-leaks): scans and redacts API keys and secrets leaked into agent session transcripts.
- [agent-blast-radius](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/agent-blast-radius): reconstructs every irreversible action an agent took (pushes, deletions, network egress) from the transcript.
- [agent-rules](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/agent-rules): checks whether the agent actually obeyed the CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules it ran under.
- [agent-cost](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/agent-cost): token and dollar forensics per session, with runaway-loop detection.

## Representative tools

- [jwt-inspector](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/jwt-inspector/): decode and verify JWTs locally, HS/RS/PS/ES algorithms, warns on alg:none.
- [csv-to-anything](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/csv-to-anything/): convert CSV/TSV to JSON, SQL, Markdown, or TypeScript interfaces in the browser.
- [og-image-generator](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/og-image-generator/): generate Open Graph images and ready-to-paste meta tags.
- [color-contrast-checker](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/color-contrast-checker/): WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios for any color pair.
- [llms-txt-generator](https://0xelitesystem.github.io/llms-txt-generator/): build a spec-compliant llms.txt for any site.

## Representative references

- [agent-failure-modes](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/agent-failure-modes): how AI coding agents fail in practice, with trace-level examples.
- [prompt-injection-defense-reference](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/prompt-injection-defense-reference): architecture-first prompt injection defense, including defenses that do not work.
- [security-headers-reference](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/security-headers-reference): the essential HTTP security headers with literal copy-paste values and a baseline CSP.
- [dns-email-authentication-reference](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/dns-email-authentication-reference): SPF, DKIM, DMARC explained with example records.
- [incident-response-runbooks](https://github.com/0xelitesystem/incident-response-runbooks): step-by-step runbooks for common security incidents.
